events.name: Freaketonas
events.description:
Fridays just got a new name. Freaketonas is Azúcar's new weekly night, every Friday from 9pm to close, with DJ Ralphy-Ray running the room on perreo, dembow, house and Latin hits. Vibras latinas start to finish: the kind of night where you come out, dance until they turn the lights on, and leave with your voice gone.

Drink specials all night: Mexican candy cocktails, tequila cocktails, and spiked horchata for the ones who know. Plus the full food menu if you need something to keep you going.

No cover. 21+. Doors at 9pm.

Azúcar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA 99301.
